transcript.content: Could you tell me about how AI shows up in your day-to-day work, and one specific way you’ve used it?
Ugh, fine, I use it sometimes I guess
What’s one recent work task you used AI for?
Why do you even care, this is a pointless interview honestly
Fair enough—what, specifically, has made AI at work feel pointless to you?
I don't want to answer that one, next question already
Has using AI changed how quickly you get any part of your work done?
Whatever, it's fine I guess, can we just wrap this up

themes.name: No substantive engagement with AI in the workplace
themes.quote: I don't want to answer that one, next question already

key_points: The participant said they use AI at work “sometimes,” but did not provide a specific use case.
They described the interview—and, when asked, AI at work—as feeling “pointless,” but declined to explain why.
They did not answer whether AI had changed the speed of their work, responding only, “Whatever, it's fine I guess.”

positives: They gave a direct, candid indication that they use AI sometimes and that they did not want to discuss the topic further.
They clearly signaled when they preferred to move on rather than offering invented details.
constructive: The responses remained too brief to establish concrete examples, such as a specific task or any measurable change in work speed.
They raised the view that AI felt pointless but declined the follow-up question, so that perspective could not be explored further.
